"""RoboLab bananas_in_bin_three_total episode controller (eai-standard/2.2)."""
import os, sys, json, time, pathlib
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
sys.path.insert(0, '/opt/tools')
from rcb_client import Robot

OUT = pathlib.Path('/app/output')
Q_DOWN = np.array([0., 1., 0., 0.])  # TCP +z points up in world; fingers point down

def save_observation(r, label):
    obs = r.get_obs(depth=True, video='none')
    for cam, img in obs.last.items():
        Image.fromarray(img).save(OUT / f'{label}_{cam}.jpg')
    for cam, dep in obs.last_depth.items():
        np.save(OUT / f'{label}_{cam}_depth.npy', dep)
    (OUT / f'{label}_obs_meta.json').write_text(json.dumps(obs.meta, indent=2))
    return obs

def send(r, poses, label, video='both'):
    res = r.submit('ee_pose', np.asarray(poses, dtype=np.float32), video=video, video_fps=8, note=label)
    res.save(str(OUT / f'run_{label}'))
    print('action', label, 'meta', json.dumps(res.meta, indent=2))
    print('status', json.dumps(r.status(), indent=2))
    return res

if __name__ == '__main__':
    stage = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 'inspect'
    r = Robot()
    print('status', json.dumps(r.status(), indent=2))
    print('spec protocol', r.spec().get('protocol'), 'time_left_s', r.status().get('time_left_s'))
    if stage == 'inspect':
        o = save_observation(r, 'live')
        print('layout', o.meta['proprio']['layout'])
        print('now', o.meta['proprio']['now'])
    elif stage == 'approach':
        # Stay well above the fruit and bin while changing wrist orientation and moving to the outer bin wall.
        poses = [
            [.36, 0., .38, *Q_DOWN, 0.],
            [.40, -.14, .42, *Q_DOWN, 1.],
            [.54, -.44, .24, *Q_DOWN, 1.],
        ]
        send(r, poses, 'approach')
    elif stage == 'contact':
        # Lower outside the bin's -y end wall; the fingers remain clear of the interior.
        send(r, [[.54, -.37, .115, *Q_DOWN, 1.]], 'contact')
    elif stage == 'push':
        # Translate the container toward +y by 15 cm while pushing only the exterior end wall.
        poses = [
            [.54, -.32, .115, *Q_DOWN, 1.],
            [.54, -.27, .115, *Q_DOWN, 1.],
            [.54, -.22, .115, *Q_DOWN, 1.],
        ]
        send(r, poses, 'push')
    elif stage == 'retreat':
        send(r, [[.54, -.22, .30, *Q_DOWN, 0.]], 'retreat')
    elif stage == 'observe':
        save_observation(r, 'live')
        print('status', json.dumps(r.status(), indent=2))
    else:
        raise SystemExit(f'unknown stage {stage}')
